messages:
Alison: Quick sync 1 Partner Y wants to list their secrets manager in our marketplace. scope: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, KMS integration (BYOK + managed option). can we triage blockers?
Ravi: I'll take KMS pathing. first Q: do we accept signed attestation PDFs or need HSM vendor TEE attestation?
Diego: SCIM model looks standard but they use group claims for role binding. we should provide a sample mapping and a minimal attribute set.
Marta: timeline from marketing: 10 business days to announcement after listing. engineering needs packaging and tests in 7 business days.
Ken: legal wants export-control check and evidence of key residency (where keys live). also ask if partner supports FIPS-certified modules.
Ravi: note: partner offers BYOK via wrapped key bundles and a managed tenant mode where we call their KMS over TLS. wrapped keys never expose raw key bytes. need to confirm their wrap algorithm (RSA-OAEP vs AES-KW).
Diego: SCIM snippet for role mapping (example):
`{ "userName": "svc-partnery", "externalId": "svc-999", "groups": [{ "value": "inference-admins", "display": "Inference Admins" }] }`
Diego: SAML metadata skeleton for console import: `
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.partnery.example"> <IDPSSODescriptor>...cert...</IDPSSODescriptor> </EntityDescriptor>`
Alison: ops question: do we require the compatibility shim for opaque rotation tokens to live in our image or partner-run? product leans partner-run to minimize our support surface.
Ravi: technical risk: partner's rotation webhook returns an opaque token and they don't expose versions. we can either 1) require versioned secrets or 2) provide a small shim that maps opaque tokens -> internal versions and persists mapping.
Diego: I can mock a tiny shim (stateless plus a small mapping DB). pseudo: `on_rotate(opaque_id): mapping[opaque_id] = mapping.get(opaque_id,0)+1` then `fetch(opaque_id, mapping[opaque_id])` with retry/backoff.
Marta: packaging: we'll reuse rdx-marketplace connector skeleton but need to add a runtime test that validates SAML upload and SCIM provisioning. ops-bot, is there an automated test template?
ops-bot: @Marta yes: https://console.internal/tests/marketplace-connector-e2e. use job tag rdx-e2e-light.
Ken: action items:
- Ravi: produce KMS attestation checklist + wrap-algorithm compatibility table (2 business days)
- Diego: SCIM + SAML examples + shim POC (2 days)
- Marta: package template + e2e job + runbook (3 days)
- Alison: draft announcement timeline + PR copy (3 days)
Alison: can we all ack by EOD so I lock announcement windows?
Diego: ack, starting examples now.
Ravi: ack, will contact partner for wrap algorithm docs and attestation PDF.
Marta: ack, will add CI job and confirm tests.
Ken: ack, will run legal/export check and confirm FIPS ask.
Alison: I'll open tracking ticket and schedule a 15-min sync tomorrow to close open items.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-9820 (partner-y marketplace KMS/SSO onboarding) assigned to Alison, Ravi, Diego, Marta, Ken. https://jira.internal/browse/INF-9820
Alison: thanks team 1 moving checklist to the ticket and close this thread. :rocket:
